 SPARTANBURG — Spartanburg Water announced a boil water advisory for the entire system on Nov. 18, excluding the Landrum area.
 Spokesperson Jennifer Candler said in a 9:31 a.m. email that the advisory is due to a “significant loss of water pressure" throughout the distribution system, which serves nearly 240,000 customers.
 Candler added in an email that there has been no confirmed contamination in the system.
 “However, as a precaution, Spartanburg Water is advising its customers to vigorously boil their water for at least one (1) full minute prior to drinking or cooking,” Candler said. “Also, any ice made from water which has not been boiled should not be used for drinking purposes.”
 She said the advisory will remain in effect until further notice.
 This story will be updated.
